item.title: 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz: Band, Channel, and Traffic Engineering for CSI Acquisition
item.description: The principles post covered the physics of CSI and the ESPectre post tore one open-source project down to its config knobs, but the moment you actually deploy a CSI node at home you face four decisions no paper writes down: should the node sit on 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz? Auto channel or manual? Is 20 MHz or 40 MHz better for sensing? And where does CSI come from when the environment goes quiet?
